primary_item.summary:
大家好，我是汤师爷。 如果你最近在学 AI Agent，大概率有过这种感觉。 教程刷了不少，提示词也收藏了一堆，可真要自己动手，还是不知道先学什么。 WorkBuddy、Codex、Skill、工作流
大家好，我是汤师爷。
如果你最近在学 AI Agent，大概率有过这种感觉。
教程刷了不少，提示词也收藏了一堆，可真要自己动手，还是不知道先学什么。
WorkBuddy、Codex、Skill、工作流、知识库、MCP，一个新名词接着一个新名词。
今天跟着视频做一个案例，明天换个平台又要重新学。收藏夹越来越满，手里的完整项目却没多几个。
我把这件事重新整理了一遍，做成了一套开源的 Agent 学习指南。
这套指南目前包含 23 篇 WorkBuddy 内容、37 篇 Coze 内容，以及 628 篇编程与架构文档。后续还会持续更新Codex、豆包工作、千问办公等Agent教程。
你可以从第一次认识 Agent 开始，一路学到办公实战、智能体搭建和企业应用开发。
不绕弯子，先把地址放出来。
GitHub开源地址：
github.com/tangshiyegit/agent-guide
在线阅

primary_item.title_original: Google's WikiSkill gives AI agents a persistent memory of past mistakes to sharpen future performance
primary_item.summary:
Google Research has introduced WikiSkill, a framework that gives AI agents a persistent knowledge base. Instead of discarding what they learned after each run, agents document both failures and successes in a wiki-like structure and use that knowledge to get better over time. Larger models benefit more, but smaller models with WikiSkill can match the performance of larger ones without it.

primary_item.title_en: LAION drops massive open video dataset with 10 million hours of footage for AI research
primary_item.title_original: LAION drops massive open video dataset with 10 million hours of footage for AI research
primary_item.summary:
LAION's Big Video Dataset (BVD) is one of the largest open video datasets for AI research, with 80 million videos, 10 million hours of runtime, and 55 million auto-described clips. Models trained on BVD beat the previous benchmark, InternVid, by up to 2.1 percentage points. Legally, LAION can likely point to a 2024 Hamburg court ruling that allows collecting copyrighted content for non-commercial research.
LAION's Big Video Dataset (BVD) is one of the largest open video datasets for AI research,
